parameters.name: AudioFormat
parameters.description: The audio format. Only **wav**, **mp3**, and **amr** formats are supported.

parameters.name: CombinationList
parameters.description:
The combination broadcast content, which includes the following types:

- To broadcast corpus that has been successfully pushed to the device, enter the identifier of the corpus.

- To broadcast supported dynamic content, pass in the value based on the specific rules supported by the device.
    
    Example: Amount, in the format of `{$xxx}`, where xxx is the specific amount. For example, `{$1000}` causes the device to broadcast **1000 yuan**.
    
The device broadcasts in the order of the delivered CombinationList.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The **DeviceName** of the device.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

parameters.name: EnforceFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to deliver a forced broadcast flag to the broadcast device.

- false (default): does not deliver
- true: delivers

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The device ID. You can call [QuerySpeechDevice](~~280408~~) to obtain this parameter.

>If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a globally unique identifier (GUID) of a device, which corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If this ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If this ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.

parameters.name: SpeechId
parameters.description:
The unique broadcast ID delivered to the device.
><notice>
If you do not specify this parameter, the system generates one. If you retry a broadcast at the business level, specify the broadcast ID of the retry to avoid duplicate business broadcasts.
></notice>
